blocks.text: Software project ki laagat ka andaza planning aur management ka aham qadam hai. Is ka matlab project mukammal karne ke kul kharchon ki peshgoi hai; durust andaza budget, wasail ki taqseem aur haqeeqat pasand tawaqqoaat mein madad deta hai.

items: Development team: developers ki tadaad, maharat aur fi ghanta ujrat; mahireen zyada lete hain.
Technology stack: chuni gayi technology, languages aur tools; kuch ko zyada wasail ya khaas ilm chahiye.
Project ki muddat: lambe projects aam taur par mehnge.
Risk management: mumkina khatron ke mansoobe kharcha barhate hain; contingency fund ghair mutawaqqo masail ke liye.
Quality assurance: testing, bugs theek karna aur maiyar poora karna.

blocks.text: Misal: Pakistan ki ek company 6 mahine (24 hafte) mein online shopping app chahti hai jis mein user registration, product listings, shopping cart, payment integration aur order tracking hon, React Native, Node.js aur MongoDB se, 1 project manager, 2 frontend developers, 2 backend developers, 1 UI/UX designer aur 2 QA testers ke saath, aur 10% contingency fund.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab contingency fund PKR 1,604,000 aur kul kharcha (total estimated cost) PKR 19,644,000 chhapti hai. Sahi hisab: upar ke chhe mad ka jama PKR 18,040,000 hai, us ka 10% PKR 1,804,000 banta hai, aur kul PKR 18,040,000 + 1,804,000 = PKR 19,844,000. Kitab ne 10% ghalat nikala, is liye kul bhi ghalat aaya.

Kul kharcha planning aur design se implementation aur testing tak development ke tamam hisson ko shamil karta aur dikhata hai ke har amil kharche mein kaise izafa karta hai. Software project shuru karne ke liye programming jaanna zaroori nahi: aap apna khayal freelancing platforms par daal sakte hain jahan developers boli lagate hain, aur sarmaya karon (investors) se paisa le sakte hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Kaunsa amil software ke kharche ke andaze par asar nahi karta (MCQ 8)? Contingency fund kis liye hai (MCQ 9)?
blocks.explanation: Hone wali meetings ki tadaad, option (c). Contingency fund ghair mutawaqqo kharchon ke liye hai, option (a), jaise daire ki tabdeeli ya integration ke masail; kitab ki answer key MCQ 9 ke liye (c) deti hai jo text se mel nahi khata.

items: Laagat ka andaza budget, wasail aur tawaqqoaat ke liye kul kharchon ki peshgoi hai; awamil: team, technology stack, muddat, khatra (contingency), quality assurance.
